```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(pathview)
```



Run pathview twice, first to find max to get abs(max) value to set new color label range
```{r}
# Options:

path_ids <- c("04140") # Autophagy

for (path_id in path_ids){
  #df = read.csv("../CriptoFc/results/DE/contrasts/contrast_Vulko293_neg_vs_Expi293_neg.csv")
  #df = read.csv("../CriptoFc/results/DE/contrasts/contrast_Vulko293_CriptoFC_vs_Expi293_CriptoFC.csv")
  df = read.csv("../results/DE/contrasts/contrast_Vulko_vs_Expi.csv")
  
  df <- df %>% filter(padj<0.05)
  
  ####################################################################################
  
  # Prepare data for pathview
  log2FC <-df$log2FoldChange
  names(log2FC) <- df$X
  
  # Run pathview 1st to get max value to set color legend...
  pv.out <- pathview(
    gene.data = log2FC, 
    pathway.id = path_id, 
    species = "hsa", 
    gene.idtype = "symbol"
  )
  
  ####################################################################################
  # Function to round up to closest 1 digit (ex 3.04 -> 3.1) to ensure whole range is within color label
  round_up <- function(x) {
    scale <- 10^1
    ceiling(x * scale) / scale
  }
  
  # Extract gene log2FC
  log2FC <- pv.out$plot.data.gene
  
  # Find abs(max) gene value and round up to nearest 1 digit
  max_val <- round_up(max(abs(log2FC$mol.data), na.rm = TRUE))
  print(max_val)
  
  ####################################################################################
  
  # Rerun pathview with updated limit range
  
  log2FC <-df$log2FoldChange
  names(log2FC) <- df$X
  
  # Run pathview
  pv.out <- pathview(
    gene.data = log2FC, 
    pathway.id = path_id, 
    species = "hsa", 
    gene.idtype = "symbol",
    limit = max_val,
    low=list(gene="#0082FF"),
    high=list(gene="#FF402C")
  )
  
  # Save genes included in pathway & values
  write.csv(pv.out$plot.data.gene, paste0("hsa",path_id,"_pathview.csv"))
}

```
